headline.text: MORPHEUS ELUDES POLICE AT HEATHROW AIRPORT

semantic_claims.claim: The article has a London dateline and says the search for Morpheus is intensifying.
A Morpheus sighting is reported to the newspaper by British intelligence.
Morpheus's identity is said to have been verified in connection with recent terrorist events in South America.
Intelligence agencies worldwide are described as pursuing Morpheus and a group called the resistance.
A local police officer at Heathrow comments on cooperation with intelligence in the pursuit.
Authorities say Morpheus's physical and cultural attributes are difficult to determine.
The article says espionage/intelligence communities are moving closer to establishing Morpheus's identity.

columns.notes: The 2004 transcription intentionally replaces most unreadable words with placeholders.

research_history.importance: Earliest detailed transcription found in this research pass; organized by article columns and explicitly marks unreadable text.
Independent-or-possibly-derivative web reproduction of several readable Heathrow passages; useful as corroboration, not sole authority.
Independent scene study that identifies readable fragments and explicitly marks illegible regions.

rendering_recommendation.headline: render-exact
rendering_recommendation.body: Do not fill gaps with purported canonical prose. Render only confirmed/compatible fragments or a clean-room reconstructed article with provenance kept separate.

notes: The web research strongly confirms the newspaper identity but did not uncover a reliable transcription of the Arabic body copy from the 1999 screen.
Do not substitute Studio C's reconstructed Arabic/other international article text for the 1999 body.
